text:
release-mgr: Heads-up — scheduled deploy of inference-routing v2 today 16:00 PT. Posting a revert/runbook readiness check. Please confirm owners, smoke criteria and rollback triggers by 15:30 PT. Deploy window 16:00–17:30. Revert target is tag v2.1.3. @maya you own smoke? @liam you on revert exec?

maya: I can own smoke. Will run the runbook checklist and post results here.

liam: I'm on revert execution if needed. Prepped revert scripts, tested on staging. ops-bot — did we pin canary capacity?

ops-bot: Canary pool reserved: 3 GPUs pinned. Alerts configured. Auto-fallback thresholds set (see later).

sanjay: Quick sanity on rollback criteria we agreed last week: 1) sustained >5% 5xx across canary for 2 minutes, 2) p99 latency >1s sustained for 2 minutes, 3) model-quality regression >3% on canary eval set. Confirm?

emily: +1 on those. Also add: if the feature-flag initialization fails on >1 host in the pool, escalate and rollback.

maya: Smoke checklist I'll run:
- health endpoints respond
- sample prompts through canary route (sanity outputs)
- KV cache warming completed for canary hosts
- token/accounting sanity (no large delta)
I'll paste pass/fail in this thread as I run.

release-mgr: Revert (dry-run) command for ops:
```
./scripts/revert-deploy.sh --tag v2.1.3 --force --brief
```
Note: real revert requires ops approval and runs in maintenance window if DB work involved. Don't execute unless criteria met.

liam: Did a dry run on staging; revert path looks clean. There are no DB migrations in this deploy (double-checked).

sanjay: :thumbsup: Incidents channel on standby #incidents. Ops watcher assigned.

maya: 15:28 PT — starting smoke run now. Health endpoints OK, sample prompts pass, KV warming OK. Small token accounting drift +0.2% vs baseline (within tolerance). Starting canary ramp per plan.

release-mgr: Canary ramp plan: 10% -> 30% -> 60% over ~15m steps. Monitor p95/p99, error rate, and eval pass rate. Auto-fallback to v2.1.3 if thresholds exceeded. We'll post metrics every 5 minutes.

emily: If we need to rollback, liam will run revert and I'll update the changelog + release notes. Who owns postmortem?

sanjay: I'll own the postmortem.

ops-bot: Auto-fallback config: error_rate>4% for 120s OR p99>900ms for 180s triggers fallback to v2.1.3. Canary monitor jobs: canary-metrics-01, canary-eval-01.

release-mgr: Go/no-go? If everyone is good, I'll kick at 16:00 PT.

maya: Go from me. :rocket:

liam: Go.

emily: Go.

sanjay: Go.

release-mgr: Kicking off deploy now. Will post canary metrics updates here every 5 minutes. If any owner sees a trigger, call revert and tag @liam @release-mgr.

ops-bot: Deploy started — canary at 10% traffic. Monitoring active.

maya: First 5m canary check: health OK, error rate 0.6%, p99 420ms, eval pass 99.6%. No rollback triggers.

release-mgr: Nice. Continue ramping to 30% in 10 minutes. Keep posting quick checks.

liam: Noted. I'm standing by with the revert runbook open.

ops-bot: Reminder: if manual revert executed, schedule blackout for 10 minutes to let systems settle before re-deploy.

release-mgr: Thanks team. Will keep thread updated and file the release checklist after full ramp.

maya: Adding final note — we validated canary logs for KV-population and there were no cache evictions beyond baseline.

sanjay: All clear from SRE side.

emily: I'll draft the minimal release note and post when ramp completes.

release-mgr: Closing loop — go completed, no revert needed. Postmortem owner: @sanjay. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
